string

QUERY PARAMETERS

string
page
int32

Possible values: >= 0

Page number (0-based)

Default value: 0
size
int32

Possible values: >= 1 and <= 100

Page size (1-100)

Default value: 10
sortBy
string

Field to sort by. Default: name. Sortable fields: id, name.

Default value: name
sortDir
string

ASC or DESC. Default: ASC.

Default value: ASC
